notes.title: Patch 1.1 Sneak Peek: Shiny Morps, Artifacts, and More!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/818c47ec12bdcf0bf5f27ab99c9723f19f323c24.png[/img]

[h3]Hello, Interns![/h3]
We're getting closer to the release of our [b]first major update since launch.[/b] In [b]patch 1.1,[/b] we will introduce some fun new features and improvements: you'll finally get to see [b]Shiny Morps[/b] in action, [b]dress them[/b] up with hats, and enjoy [b]full controller support[/b] for a smoother gameplay experience. Keep reading for a sneak peek at what we’re working on right now!

[h2]Shinies & Morp-Hats![/h2]
We're not just giving you more ways to [b]customize your Morps[/b], but we're also adding more variety to [b]Morps themselves[/b]! [b]Pop a hat on your favorite regular Morp[/b], or go all out and [b]dress up a Shiny version[/b] to really show off. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/4a6bfc8836f022e68f9ee4a55f5d41d035ed4114.png[/img]
[h2]The Archive & Artifacts![/h2] 
This new mechanic adds a [b]fun side activity[/b] for collectors and for players who love keeping a stash of resources, just in case. [b]The Archive [/b]is closely tied to [b]Artifacts[/b], which we're also adding to the game. Players will be able to find [b]Artifacts[/b] [b]all over the world[/b] while performing various activities, then turn them in at the Archive for some [b]cool rewards![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/d941e282b6a576c1ba1ddc189e1de0bc7f649d31.png[/img]
[h2]New Player Skins![/h2]
You’ll have the chance to [b]personalize[/b] your character [b]even more[/b]. Whether you want to create a unique look, new skins will help you truly associate yourself with your in-game persona. It's all about making your character stand out and [b]reflect your style![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/357b5e5af564acc95128e23b57e92e0626c4b9fc.png[/img]
[h2]More Decor![/h2]
It’s going to be easier than ever to make your world feel [b]even more cozy and personal[/b] with all [b]new additions of decor[/b]. Don’t be shy, let your [b]creativity run wild[/b] and build some [b]awesome creations![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/307ce9303701c1ecf6a2cbc1d3f0642d0db25d43.png[/img]
[h2]Controller Support![/h2]
The [b]controller support rework [/b]is almost complete! With [b]patch 1.1[/b], it’ll be [b]fully integrated into the game[/b], offering a much more [b]immersive experience[/b] for [b]controller lovers.[/b]

[h2]And More![/h2]
Balance tweaks, error fixes, other improvements, and more changes for a better gameplay experience!

[h2]Discount![/h2]
We are celebrating our participation in [b]Creature Collector Fest[/b] with a [b]cheeky discount,[/b] so don't miss your chance to [b]try out Time to Morp if you’ve always wanted to! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/977510/Time_to_Morp/

[b]Pumped about upcoming patch 1.1?[/b] Got any questions, feedback, or you want to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/977510/discussions/0/4298193819409389070/

notes.title: The Archive, Morp-Hats, and More – Exciting Update Awaits!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/6bed9ce93f34f57ac4abac83c9838831dcec350a.png[/img]

[h3]Hello, Interns![/h3]
We have a bit more stuff to share with you before [b]Time to Morp[/b] will be released from [b]Early Access.[/b] From [b]the archive mechanic[/b] and [b]Morp-hats[/b] to [b]new NPCs[/b] and reworked [b]dialogues[/b], there’s plenty to look forward to. Let’s dive into all the fresh content coming your way [b]soon![/b]

[h2]The Archive[/h2]
The Archive is a [b]new mechanic[/b] we're adding that lets you [b]store[/b] collected [b]resources [/b]like seeds, fish, and more to help future explorers! It'll extend gameplay for [b]collectors [/b]and [b]completionists [/b]while also [b]expanding automation[/b] and [b]rewarding [/b]players with emotes, skins, and decor.

Don’t forget to show off your rarest finds on a pedestals (newly added items) and flaunt your achievements. We'll try to add everything with the full release, but if not, it'll be available shortly after!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/50c42537dc3567db5061ce7bcd02e9d540515c74.png[/img]

[h2]New: NPCs[/h2]
To conclude the [b]game’s story[/b], we’re adding [b]2 new NPCs[/b], each with their own backgrounds and issues that’ll need your help to solve!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/244096859e5e248b5a938da98531fefde8ed3eab.png[/img]

[h2]Reworked Dialogues[/h2]
We’re reworking not only [b]dialogue UI[/b], but we are also adding more [b]lore [/b]and [b]personality [/b]to each NPC!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/8ef250a2693fbf41329be4446d5aee6d3e56961d.gif[/img]

[h2]Updated Cozy Look[/h2]
We are improving [b]several aspects[/b] of the game for a cozier look! New changes will include: reworked [b]colors[/b], new [b]models[/b], and revamped[b] UI[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/7ca083ef31a0dcab8a6430e03631c1c96e96b315.gif[/img]

[h2]Morp-Hats![/h2]
A lot of you loved festive [b]Morp-hats[/b], so we’re expanding hats collection and turning it into [b]a new mechanic [/b]— we want to let you [b]craft hats[/b] and put them on your Morps yourself. And again, we'll try to add everything with the full release, but if not, it'll be available [b]shortly after!
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/c20098a59fa11cb2dadf6c4910d9dfccf62249c2.png[/img]

[h2]Bags of Goods[/h2]
Sometimes, while doing [b]activities [/b]like exploring, mining, fishing, and others, you'll have a [b]chance [/b]to find [b]bags of goods[/b] filled with [b]rewards [/b]like recipes and resources — adding more excitement to the usual gameplay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/194ec0d075ddfba16368a4a8f756030a375595a0.png[/img]

[h2]New: Seed Extractor[/h2]
We’re adding [b]tech [/b]to improve the [b]farming experience[/b] and bring it closer to [b]full automation! [/b]The [b]seed extractor[/b] works like this: you feed it your harvest, and it recycles everything into random seeds — plus a little extra, allowing you to hunt for seeds you need and toss unwanted ones back into seed extractor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/29eec17fc53c6cc986aa886026f5dc0798389b17.gif[/img]

[h2]New: Decor Extractor[/h2]
Another [b]new tech,[/b] this one lets you convert any resource into [b]currency [/b]—  this results in even more automation as you won't need to collect it manually. You can use this currency in[b] NPC shops [/b]to buy [b]decor [/b]and [b]cool abilities![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/2463f8dab0f5d034395bd3ae3e284672a73d9d12.gif[/img]

[h2]Even More Lore[/h2]
We’re adding [b]even more quests[/b] that dive into the story of the world and its NPCs, letting you fully immerse in what's happening around you! No spoilers, though.

Any questions or feedback? Don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us through any of our social media channels!

notes.title: Big Reputation Changes Ahead!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/91034357b9c827d35f9dcef330822e640a7cd8c0.png[/img]

[h3]Hello, Interns![/h3]
We're not slowing down and are still hard at work improving [b]Time to Morp[/b] and keeping you updated on the changes! Today’s topic will cover everything related to your [b]reputation [/b] amongst Morps and NPCs — how we are making levelling up of it to be more [b]integrated into the story,[/b] updated [b]rewards[/b], new [b]optional events[/b] with NPCs, and more. Keep reading to learn all the details!

[h2]Level Up Reputation[/h2]
Deliver food for Morps or NPCs to boost your reputation with them! You can even complete these tasks daily if you want, so no more waiting around. There will be an additional way to level up your reputation with Morps, picture this: you’re running through the forest, spot a sad Morp, pick it up, and suddenly a quest appears: “I’m sad, I need a hug, please!” 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/664b8e5e8965a66cefd61763bf163e9752681a27.gif[/img]

[h2]Useful Rewards[/h2]
NPCs will reward you with[b] better tools[/b] and [b]more awesome abilities[/b] as you level up your reputation with them! Pretty awesome, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/dc32e218c53d16332fd52535129480f5db53f544.jpg[/img]

[h2]Shops[/h2]
Want more than just the rewards NPCs offer? No problem! Each NPC will have [b]their own shop[/b] where you can buy [b]gadgets[/b], rare [b]resources[/b], [b]ingredients[/b], and other [b]unique[/b] items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/6acdd4f4652016da6be681b6bfdf7cff0603d429.png[/img]

[h2]NPC Areas[/h2]
Each NPC will want their [b]own cozy space[/b] too, completed with [b]fences[/b] and [b]decorations[/b] to make it look pretty. It should really feel like a [b]charming little village[/b], with each house uniquely decorated and full of personality! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/d97e0635a2d2e401bf8b106b6001624e2c62b4eb.png[/img]

[h2]Better Reputation = More Lore[/h2]
The better your reputation with an NPC is, the more they'll trust you and open up about themselves. [b]Optional dialogues[/b] will be added for you to explore, giving [b]more backstory [/b]on each NPC!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/12170a73057dc7fdb7e0c9d496160d16e65750dc.gif[/img]

[h2]And There is More![/h2]
Here are some other changes we’re planning to add — hopefully right on time:
[list]
[*]Level Up your reputation with NPCs by progressing through the [b]main story[/b] — become a valuable team member and a [b]respected Intern[/b] for all the hard work you’ve put in! 
[*]As you level up your reputation with each NPC, you’ll unlock more and [b]more decor[/b] to personalize your space how you like! 
[*][b]Random events[/b] — NPCs might ask you to [b]meet them at a bench[/b] to stargaze together, reminisce about the past, or maybe you’ll have to track down an [b]Explorer[/b] hanging out on a cliff somewhere...
[*]NPCs will start [b]walking around[/b] if you build [b]roads[/b] for them! It’ll make the world feel even more alive as they explore their surroundings
[/list]
[h2]Join our Socials[/h2]
Any questions or feedback? Don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us through any of our social media channels!

notes.title: [0.15.6] Big rebalancing update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/18bbbf58943d4b6b03370cc7f421755e71de70bc.png[/img]

[h3]Hello Interns![/h3]
With the [b]Double the Fun Update[/b] release, we got some awesome feedback from the community. The goal of this update was to speed up early game so players can get to more enjoyable aspects, like [b]automation [/b]and [b]Morps management[/b], more quickly. We reduced [b]Electron [/b]requirements overall, so players won’t need to run back and forth between [b]Electron Veins[/b] and [b]their base[/b] as much. We also moved [b]Gello [/b]requirements and production to later game to cut down standing around and waiting times. We’ve also increased mining speeds and improved production for early game Morps. Overall, the game should involve much less running around and be easier to get into! Check out the full list of changes here:

[h3]Researcher[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Improved prices:[/b] bunch of unlocks no longer require [b]Electrons [/b]
[*][b]Elevator pipe [/b]unlocks along with the [b]Pump[/b] now 
[*][b]Gello Cooker[/b] research unlock is now [b]cheaper[/b]
[*][b]Bowl [/b]no longer requires [b]Energy Cells[/b] to be unlocked
[*][b]Simple Sprinkler[/b] no longer requires [b]Gello [/b]to be unlocked
[*][b]Cooking Pot[/b] no longer requires [b]Water[/b] to be unlocked (requires [b]Pebbles [/b]instead)
[*]Unlocking second [b]Well [/b]is easier now 
[*][b]Chest [/b]no longer requires [b]Batteries[/b] to be unlocked
[*][b]Gello Cooker[/b] research now requires [b]Protons [/b]instead of [b]Electrons[/b]
[*][b]Extractor [/b]is cheaper to unlock now
[*][b]Dispenser[/b] is cheaper to unlock now
[*][b]Seeder [/b]requires less [b]Leafs [/b]to be unlocked
[*][b]Well [/b]no longer requires [b]Electrons [/b]to be unlocked
[*]First [b]Emotes [/b]are easier to unlock now
[/list]
[h3]Morps[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Young Red Morps[/b] and [b]Red Morps[/b] produce more resources now
[*][b]Blue Morps[/b] and [b]Better Blue Morps[/b] produce more [b]Protons[/b] now
[*][b]Young Red Morps[/b] and [b]Blue Morps[/b] require less [b]Sugar [/b]to evolve 
[*][b]Tech Morps[/b] eat[b] Energy Cells[/b] now [b](check your Areas with them!)[/b]
[*][b]Pink Morps[/b] eat [b]Tech Points[/b] now [b](check your Areas with them!)[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Extractor Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*]Level 1 is [b]cheaper [/b]to unlock and no longer requires [b]Gello[/b]
[*]Level 2 is [b]cheaper [/b]to unlock and no longer requires [b]Knowledge Points[/b]
[*]Level 3 is [b]cheaper [/b]to unlock
[/list]
[h3]Questing[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reorganized [b]quests [/b]to start with [b]automation [/b]sooner
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Social Quest[/b] "Bring me Fruits" requires 1 entity instead of 5 now
[*][b]Speed [/b]of [b]manual gathering[/b] was reduced (Morp production was improved instead)
[*]Collecting resources from [b]Chests [/b]is [b]4 times faster[/b] now
[*][b]Gathering speed[/b] of [b]logs[/b] is [b]2 times faster[/b] now
[*][b]Gathering speed[/b] for other resources is now adjusted to have similar numbers
[*][b]Gathering speed[/b] of [b]farming Crops[/b] is [b]2 times faster[/b] now
[*]Pick-up speed of [b]Extractor [/b]is [b]2 times faster[/b] now
[*][b]Well [/b]no longer requires [b]Electrons [/b]to be build
[*][b]Well [/b]generates water supply [b]2 times faster[/b] now, gathering speed for water from [b]Well [/b]is doubled too
[*][b]Proton Deposits[/b] store [b]3 times more[/b] resources now 
[*][b]Proton Deposits[/b] are [b]doubled[/b] at starting location 
[*][b]Rocks[/b] now contain less [b]Pebbles [/b]inside
[*]Storage size of [b]Big Simple Chest[/b] is doubled now
[*][b]Chest [/b]no longer costs [b]Batteries [/b]to build
[*]Production speed of [b]Gello Cookers[/b] is doubled 
[*]Crafting of [b]Uprooter and Terraforming Gadgets:[/b] prices are halved, output amount of gadgets [b]doubled[/b]
[*][b]Social Quests[/b] for [b]Engineer [/b]and [b]Mechanic [/b]are faster to get now
[*]Reduced the amount of [b]Electrons [/b]needed to build a bunch of different [b]Tech[/b]
[*]Added [b]FOV [/b]slider in options 
[*]Building price for [b]Farming Plot[/b] is decreased now
[*][b]Chests [/b]can store [b]Seeds [/b]now
[*]Changed logic for [b]Bowls[/b]: [b]Simple Pumps[/b] now only count resources in [b]Bowls [/b]and no longer count resources in the rest of the [b]Area[/b]
[*][b]Elevator pipe[/b] is cheaper to build now
[*]Improved descriptions for some [b]Tech[/b]
[*]Improved [b]Morp-Wiki[/b] descriptions for [b]Blue Morps[/b]
[*]Added [b]new quest[/b] to build a [b]Pump[/b]
[*]Reduced [b]Proton[/b] requirements for [b]Tech[/b]
[*]It's no longer required to build [b]stairs [/b]for the [b]quest[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

notes.title: Biggest Update! (v0.9)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/33d782f4b75f8d9565945573452868ff3dbfc57b.png[/img]

We added so much, but in the end, it doesn't even stop us from adding even more! And we did exactly that! More tech, more decor, more mechanics, just ... more!

[h2]How to join?[/h2]
Find "Join the Time to Morp Playtest" on the main page of the game, and [b]press "Request Access"[/b] (you will get it immediately).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/77e90a2d8ab423e21f3d27bd3e4362e1811f635d.png[/img]

[h3]Where to send feedback?[/h3]
Start a discussion here on Steam, or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/SdWBfVS]Discord Server[/url] to discuss your experience directly with us in [b]#playtest[/b] channel. We will be waiting!

[h3]For how long the Playtest will last?[/h3]
We will [b]close the playtest on Aug 11th[/b] to go through your feedback and then shift our focus back to development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/0d5f4493b9c76cef84cbd88ee2b345050dbdaa52.jpg[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes (v0.9)[/h2]
[i]Idea behind this patch is to simplify the early game, giving simple and understandable tools at first, and then replacing them with more advanced technology later in the game.
Another goal is to go more in the direction of “building a town”, adding more NPCs, Housing mechanics and fully reworking how Decor looks and works.[/i]

[i]NOTE: Old save files (from v0.8) won't work with the new patch (v0.9)![/i]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]

[*][b]New Mechanic: Reputation[/b]
(Players can complete Quests to increase reputation with Morps and the Crew to get rewards)
[*][b]New Mechanic: Cooking[/b]
(Players can cook complex dishes to feed Morps and the Crew)
[*][b]New Mechanic: Housing[/b]
(Crew members now require a House to stay at. This mechanic will be expanded in future patches)
[*][b]New Mechanic: Player Emotes[/b]
(Players can now use emotes and even Play with Morps!)
[*][b]New Mechanic: Bowls[/b]
(Simple version to move specific items between Areas without dealing with Conditions)
[*][b]New Progression: All early technology is simplified[/b]
(Added simpler versions for all buildings to ensure a smoother learning curve)
[*][b]New Research Tree: +50% more nodes to unlock[/b]
(bloat, bloat, BLOAT)
[*][b]New Decor: around 40 new items to decorate with[/b]
(Decor mechanic was simplified, allowing easier access and building)
[*][b]New NPCs: Meet 3 new Crew members![/b]
(they're useless right now, but they're there!)
[/list]
[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New Building: Roads (increases Player movement speed)
[*]New Quests (to teach new mechanics)
[*]New Building: Well (fast and easy access to water)
[*]Some Morps are simplified (to prevent unnecessary morphing)
[*]Updated Map (More verticality)
[*]Updated Plant (more visible, animated)
[*]Updated Ground (better colors, smoother edges, more noticeable levels)
[*]Optimization (how ground and biomes are drawn)
[*]Bug Fixes / UX Improvements
[/list]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/3a8a7f5ec63afa0cdb91b80d03b9968239e922a4.png[/img]

We coded, we fixed, we coded more, and we delivered! The new version is here! 0.8.1 to be specific! Come and get it!

[h2]How to join?[/h2]
Find "Join the Time to Morp Playtest" on the main page of the game, and [b]press "Request Access"[/b] (you will get it immediately).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/77e90a2d8ab423e21f3d27bd3e4362e1811f635d.png[/img]

[h3]What to expect from the game?[/h3]
Current [b]version of the game is v0.8[/b], meaning that nothing is final and there is little content to play with. So expect missing mechanics and some imbalance, but you should be able to get the feeling of the game and have fun for several hours!

[h3]Where to send feedback?[/h3]
Start a discussion here on Steam, or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/SdWBfVS]Discord Server[/url] to discuss your experience directly with us in [b]#playtest[/b] channel. We will be waiting!

[h3]For how long the Playtest will last?[/h3]
We will [b]close the playtest on March 9th[/b] to go through your feedback and then shift our focus back to development.

[h2]Patch Notes (v0.8)[/h2]
[i]In this patch we fully reworked how late-game mechanics work, as well as expanded on Liquid production and transportation. We also updated Player Customization, visuals for NPCs, and added long requested feature: Scan! You can finally find anything on the map! How awesome is that?![/i]

[i]NOTE: Old save files (from v0.7) won't work with the new patch (v0.8)![/i]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New Tech: Laser Heater, Water Stove, Smart Sprinklers[/b]
New liquid resources and recipes, adding more automation around water
[*][b]New Mechanic: Scan[/b]
Ability to find any Resource/Morp on the Map
[*][b]Polluted Deposits reworked[/b]
Reworked Pollution, allowing for more straight forward automation
[*][b]Player Customization 2.0[/b]
3D faces, gadgets/costumes/glasses, more variations/colors
[*][b]Morp Wiki 2.0[/b]
Progression for unlocks, contains Resources/Environment, possible to show "Related Entities", Diet/Production for Morps, and so on.
[*][b]Chat 2.0[/b]

[*]New NPC models/animations
[*]Cutscenes updated

[*]New Quests, Tutorials, Research

[*]Renderer optimization
